definitions.short: a lot (as by means of a broken piece)
definitions.full: H6332. Pur מּוּר noun masculine lot (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; perhaps Assyrian loanword from puru, buru, stone Jen ZA x. 339 f. and in Wild Est p. 173 f. ); **Scheft 49f. compare Old Iranian fravi , etc., progress, fortune, fate, lot. — explained by הַגּוֺרָל Est 3:7 ; 9:24 ; הַמּוּר שֵׁם 9:26 explains name of feast מּוּרִים 9:26 ; הַמֻּרִים יְמֵי days of Purim 9:28 ; 9:31 ; הַמּ ׳אִגֶּרֶת 9:29 , הַמּ ׳דִּבְרֵי 9:32 . — See on Purim especially Now Archaeology ii. 194 ff and references . I. פור (check of following; possibly foam , compare Arabic (), , boil, ferment ; Syriac , Ethpe`el, of anger).
